spatial_reference: left/right identify the two fixed world-coordinate drawers. stove side/drawer side identify the two fixed completion-button stations; none of these terms refer to left/right pixels in a camera image.
high_level_instruction: You have two tasks to complete. Task A: use the stove's control knob to turn on the heating function and heat the water, then turn off the heating after the water has heated for a while. Task B: go to the other side of the workspace and inspect both drawers, opening each drawer, looking inside, and closing it. After both tasks are complete, press either green button at the two ends to indicate completion.

turn_on_heating.label: turn on the stove heating using the control knob

turn_off_heating.label: turn off the stove heating using the control knob

press_stove_side_button.label: press the green button on the stove side

press_drawer_side_button.label: press the green button on the drawer side
